description: A shell script used to test Git Large File Storage (LFS) integration with Perforce repositories, including cloning, file handling based on size, extension, and compression thresholds, as well as managing files with Git LFS.

methods.name: test_file_in_lfs
methods.description: Verifies a file's version, size, and content against expected values, and checks if the corresponding LFS object exists and matches the expected content.

methods.name: test_file_count_in_dir
methods.description: Checks the number of files in a directory against an expected count.
